synthesis

Charge and degas PbI2/ODE

All synthesis experiments are described as under N2. Degas 0.075 mmol PbI2 in 2.5 mL ODE at 60 °C for 30 min. Unlike the FA preparation, this sentence does not specify vacuum pressure or explicitly name a vacuum atmosphere for the degassing stage. Unreported: degassing pressure.

03
synthesis

Inject selected OA volume

At 135 °C inject the selected OA volume of 0.4, 0.6 or 0.8 mL, then inject 0.2 mL OAm. These pairs correspond to source OAm:OA volume ratios 1:2, 1:3 and 1:4. They are alternative condition choices, not three successive OA charges. Alternative OA low volume: 0.4 mL; select only the paired condition. Alternative OA middle volume: 0.6 mL; select only the paired condition. Alternative OA high volume: 0.8 mL; select only the paired condition.
